title: MQL-0008 - Approved Corpus v2.1 Hybrid RAG
question: Does hybrid retrieval of examples from the approved corpus v2.1 (3,445 records, sql2mql-v2.1 / verifier 3.1) improve Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct cross-engine execution accuracy on the 892 MQL-0006 items, versus zero-shot?

model.label: qwen2.5-coder-3b-instruct
model.dtype_note: MQL-0006 and MQL-0007 ran bfloat16 on a Tesla T4 (emulated bf16). Required, never substituted: the notebook fails if unsupported.
model.oom_policy: a batch that hits CUDA OOM is retried one prompt at a time (same prompt/dtype/decoding) and the record says so

prompt.rag_rule: RAG prompt = zero-shot prompt with one reference block inserted before the final 'Question:' line; empty context => byte-identical to zero-shot

evaluation.source: MQL-0006 bundle nl2mql_spider_dev_1034_bundle_v2 (gold SQL, gold rows and SQLite files are NOT shipped); the same 892 ids as MQL-0006 and MQL-0007

corpus.name: approved_corpus_v2_1
corpus.status: CONDITIONAL GO - APPROVED FOR TRAINING UNDER LOCAL VALIDATION POLICY (2026-11-16)
corpus.review_label: AI-reviewed (G-AIR, AI-only protocol); never human-reviewed. Labels validated on local MongoDB 8.0.34 with verifier 3.1; never executed on Atlas.

retrieval.index: per target database, target-db documents excluded
retrieval.dedup: same doc_id, same MQL, or same normalised question: higher-ranked copy kept

context.token_budgeting: Qwen2.5 tokenizer at the pinned revision (HF AutoTokenizer, add_special_tokens=False) over system+user text and the block; over-budget documents are skipped (dropped_budget), never truncated

arm_a_zero_shot.label: A. zero-shot (always generated in this run; MQL-0006 predictions are not reused)

arm_b_hybrid_rag.label: B. hybrid RAG, k=3, no guide cards, approved corpus v2.1 (the MQL-0007 arm C_hybrid_k3 with the corpus replaced)

leakage_gates.decided_before_running: thresholds and rule are the MQL-0007 ones (fixed 2026-11-06); re-applied to the approved corpus v2.1 on 2026-11-16 before any plan was built
leakage_gates.exact: normalised (lowercase alphanumeric tokens) eval question == corpus question or question_raw; raw string equality is checked as well
leakage_gates.on_any_hit: STOP beyond the acknowledged pairs; the corpus is never filtered or modified

acknowledged_near_duplicates.decision: MQL-0007 rule (user, 2026-11-06), re-applied unchanged: corpus unmodified; deterministic evaluation-specific retrieval exclusion in the RAG arm
acknowledged_near_duplicates.reason: same question template differing in one entity word ('editors'/'teachers'/'conductors'); different databases and schemas; no shared answer

retrieval_exclusions_note: Evaluation-specific, deterministic, applied to the RAG arm after ranking (index/IDF/dedup untouched). Corpus file unchanged; both evaluation items stay in the 892-item set.
stated_differences_from_MQL-0007: retrieval corpus: approved corpus v2.1 (3,445 records, sha256 96552f06...dd199bf) instead of provisional corpus v1 (3,589 records). This is the intended change.
two arms only: no random arm (B_random_k3) and no supplementary sensitivity arm (D_supp_allow_near_dup)
arm A is always generated in this run; MQL-0006 predictions are neither bundled nor reused

corpus record layout: v2.1 records have no schema.touched, source.split or verification.status. The database-level 'text_number' pattern flag, derived from schema.touched in MQL-0007, is therefore empty; it was also empty for all 123 databases of corpus v1, so the features are computed identically. Eligibility is checked on verification.outcome == ACCEPTED, verifier 3.1, converter sql2mql-v2.1 and spider_train ids.

plan rows additionally store selected_ranks; prediction records additionally store model id/revision, generation settings and (RAG arm) the retrieved ids, ranks, scores, budget decisions and the retrieval configuration fingerprint
output layout: predictions/<arm>/ instead of models/<arm>/; arm names arm_a_zero_shot and arm_b_hybrid_rag

protected-set membership (Spider dev incl. the 65 held-out items, Spider test) is NOT re-read: every approved record has the same id, question, question_raw, SQL and database as its corpus v1 record, whose membership checks were zero in MQL-0007, so the result carries over to this subset; held-out database names are checked directly
